create.title: Direct character-Stieltjes birth-block reciprocal-curvature bound
create.statement_tex: At W=Y^(7/16), D=Y^(1/2), L=Y^(1/6), fix D/L<=B<=D, Q_B=min(B,BD/(WL)), lambda_B=YL/(DB^2), one exact character-split M1 or M2 package, and one Mobius progression b'=rho v with rho|a'. Let N_rho asymp Q_B/rho, Lambda_rho=lambda_B rho^2, and K_rho=min(N_rho,N_rho sqrt(Lambda_rho)+Lambda_rho^(-1/2)). In the exact discrete Stieltjes representation, first fix one denominator threshold, Abel-sum the common chi_4(g) against the fixed sampled-BV lift factor before a modulus, partition v into the literal floor plateaux floor(t/(rho v)), apply weighted second-derivative summation on each plateau, and recombine the bounded Stieltjes mass last. Since N_rho Lambda_rho asymp L rho (J_B-1) and N_rho Lambda_rho >= D/W, every nonconstant plateau endpoint is absorbed. Uniformly for the two M1 quarter phases and the M2 phase, including all integer derivative aliases, both endpoint stars, threshold equalities, hard samples, floors, taper, clipping, Mobius progressions, and half-open shell owners, the branch sum is O_epsilon(K_rho L^(-1)Y^epsilon). This is a direct fixed-Stieltjes-mass theorem, not a bound by the completed V2 norm.
create.next_action: Use this as the terminal inner reciprocal/lift estimate. Any further saving must come from signed coupling of the remaining numerator increments or outer rays; do not reintroduce a generic completed-V2 norm.

create.title: Complete all-reduced-denominator-shell reciprocal-curvature saving
create.statement_tex: For the complete literal W=Y^(7/16), D=Y^(1/2), L=Y^(1/6) fixed determinant block, decompose the inner reduced denominator into half-open shells D/L<=B<=D. The direct character-Stieltjes birth-block lemma and the Mobius divisor sum give inner cost K_B/L, where K_B=min(Q_B,Q_B sqrt(lambda_B)+lambda_B^(-1/2)). The accepted complete outer ledger has O(LD) outer rays, O(L) numerator increments, outer coefficient O(L^(-1)), and inner coefficient K_B/L, hence each shell costs D K_B. Uniformly for B=Y^b, 1/3<=b<=1/2, Q_B sqrt(lambda_B)=Y^(11/48) and lambda_B^(-1/2)<=Y^(1/6), so every shell and their logarithmic sum are O_epsilon(Y^(35/48+epsilon)). This includes the equal-ray diagonal, threshold equality residuals, both M1 branches, M2, all literal owners, and extends the previously top-shell-only Y^(35/48) bound to the complete block. It remains Y^(11/48) above the Y^(1/2) determinant target and yields no global exponent improvement.
create.next_action: The inner reciprocal/lift and lower-shell seams are closed at Y^(35/48). Seek a genuinely joint signed saving across numerator increments or outer rays of Y^(11/48), avoiding the accepted unit-Hessian sequential-transform self-return.

create.title: Completed-V2 norm-relative reciprocal-curvature obstruction
create.statement_tex: For the endpoint-inclusive discrete V2 norm, the exact dual is the prefix-sum variance norm, equivalently the Dirichlet path Green kernel (L_N^(-1))_(jk)=min(j,k)(N+1-max(j,k))/(N+1). On the top one-lift rho=1 shell, take a compact real triangular sampled-BV denominator profile of width comparable to Lambda^(-1/2) centered at an exact reciprocal integer first-derivative alias; the same construction survives both M1 quarter shifts. Its oscillatory sum is bounded below at fixed scale while its completed V2 norm times K is smaller by Y^(1/48), with both V2 endpoint values zero. Hence |S(U)|<<||U||_(V2)K Y^epsilon is false for the displayed bounded-mass Stieltjes threshold class. The obstruction concerns only replacement of the fixed Stieltjes mass by the completed norm and does not contradict the direct absolute birth-block theorem.
create.next_action: Reject completed-norm substitutions. Use the exact fixed Stieltjes mass and threshold-first proof whenever this family is estimated.

The needed physical numerical conclusion is instead proved directly: thresholdwise character Abel followed by plateau curvature and Stieltjes Minkowski gives K_rho/L for every branch and divisor progression, with K_rho=min(N_rho,N_rho sqrt(lambda_B rho^2)+(lambda_B rho^2)^(-1/2)). The identity N_rho lambda_B rho^2 asymp L rho (J_B-1) removes every J_B endpoint loss. The complete outer ledger therefore gives Y^(35/48+epsilon) over all B-shells, stronger than the former conditional Y^(73/96) forecast. The route is closed at this fixed-block exponent, which persists only to 7/18>1/3 and does not improve the global theorem.
